item.title: Evening Weather for Sunday, September 06
item.description: Good evening! It's the weekend. No school today! Here's your weather for Sunday, September 6. Sunday. A slow and cosy sort of day. Shanghai is going to be drizzly today. Temperatures will go up to 30 degrees, with a low of 24. Rain is about 88 percent likely today. Don't forget your umbrella today! A good day for a warm drink and a story. And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be a little bit rainy, with a high of 30 degrees. A question for you: who would you like to give a hug to today? That's all from the weather desk. Enjoy your day!
